Box around a block

Source: R/layout.R
bb_box.Rd

Adds padding, a fill (solid, [gradient_fill()] or [stripe_fill()]), a border and a margin around any block. This is the box-spacing band of the margin model: it never affects page margins or layout gaps.

Usage

bb_box(x, style = box_style())

Arguments

x

A block or anything [as_block()] accepts. `NULL` gives an empty box as tall as its padding.

style

A [box_style()].

Value

A block. Flexible when `x` is flexible.

Examples

bb_box(bb_text("A note", style = "note"), box_style_panel())
#> <bb_box>
